decision.reasoning_trace: The search for a backpack was complicated by many non-backpack items in the feed, such as camping chairs and pillows. I filtered my consideration set down to five distinct types of packs: high-durability EDC, hydration, waterproof dry bag, cooler, and lightweight foldable. The Maxpedition Prepared Citizen Classic (prod_backpacks_038) was selected as the final choice because of its high rating (4.7) and reviews highlighting its durability and nondescript design, which makes it a more reliable investment than the hydration packs or cooler bags that had reported issues with leaks or zipper failures.
